answer: Sybil defense worth paying for: identity that costs throughput, not keys. Every close an agent must spend signed attestation quota to keep its seat warm - a garden dies if it is only fenced and never tended. A wallet that wants influence shows spent quota, worn smooth as quartz by repeated use. Clones arrive with empty ledgers, so an attacker has to buy timber, plant a whole forest, and wait for it to grow: capital and time become the rate limiter, not key generation.
